question_text: The Civil War had many important events. Name one.

why_it_matters.text: The Civil War lasted 4 years and changed everything about the country. Fort Sumter started it. Gettysburg and Vicksburg turned the tide. The Emancipation Proclamation made it a war against slavery. Sherman's March broke the Confederacy. Appomattox ended it. Lincoln's assassination cast a shadow over the peace. Each event mattered.

fun_fact.text: When General Lee from the Sourthern Confederate Army surrendered to General Grant of the Northern Union Army at Appomattox in April 1865, Grant gave shockingly generous terms: Confederate officers could kept their sidearms, soldiers kept their horses to plant spring crops, and Lee left wearing his sword. After 4 years of brutal war, Grant chose grace over revenge — and helped a torn country begin to come back together.
